statements.t: Due to changes to U.S. trade policy, such as increased tariffs on imports and including non-U.S. retaliatory tariffs, we have and will continue to assess potential impacts on our business.
As needed, we will pursue options to mitigate the impact of tariffs, including through our supply chain and potential exemptions and exclusions.
Given the uncertainties around U.S. trade policy and future tariff rates, we are unable to predict the nature of the tariffs and whether we will be able to successfully mitigate their impact.

In 2026, we expect the Pillar Two provisions to result in additional tax expense of approximately $45.0 million prior to offsets under current law.
We plan to vigorously contest the additional tax claimed by the IRS through the judicial process.
We intend to pursue all available remedies with respect to any unagreed issues, including administrative appeals and, if necessary, litigation, a process that could extend over several years.

We consider several factors in determining when to execute share repurchases, including, among other things, expected dilution from stock plans, cash capacity, and the market price of our common stock.

“We delivered strong third-quarter growth of 11.2% which exceeded expectations, with broad-based performance across our businesses and regions, giving us the confidence to raise our full-year outlook,” said Bernard Zovighian, CEO of Edwards Lifesciences.

The company continues to expect adjusted gross profit margin to be at the lower end of its full-year 78% to 79% gross margin guidance, driven by the impacts of currency fluctuations through the company’s hedging program.
The company expects R&D expense as a percentage of sales to be approximately 16.5% in 2026.

In 2026, Edwards continues to expect full-year operating profit margin to be at the high end of the company’s original 28% to 29% guidance range, resulting in approximately 150 basis points of constant currency operating margin expansion for the full year.

As a result of the company’s strong third quarter results, Edwards is increasing its full-year 2026 sales growth rate guidance to approximately 11.5% from 10% to 11% and TAVR product group sales growth guidance to 9% to 9.5% from 8% to 9%.
The company is also reaffirming mid-single-digit growth guidance in Surgical.
For the fourth quarter of 2026, the company projects total sales to be between $1.67 and $1.75 billion and adjusted EPS of $0.61 to $0.69.
The company will be hosting a conference call today at 2:00 p.m.

The Company is not able to provide a reconciliation of the non-GAAP guidance to comparable GAAP measures due to the unknown effect, timing, and potential significance of special charges or gains, and management's inability to forecast charges associated with future transactions and initiatives.
Provision for Income Taxes - The income tax impacts of the expenses and gains discussed above are based upon the items' forecasted effect upon the Company's full-year effective tax rate.
